title: How Account Abstraction (ERC-4337) Works
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    U["User signs UserOperation"] --> B["Bundler packs UserOps"]
    B --> EP["EntryPoint singleton"]
    subgraph Validation
        EP --> VA["account.validateUserOp"]
        EP --> VP["paymaster.validatePaymasterUserOp"]
        VA --> SIG{"ERC-1271 signature valid?"}
    end
    SIG -->|mismatch| FAIL["Return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED"]
    VP --> GAS["Paymaster sponsors gas"]
    subgraph Execution
        EX["account executes callData"] --> T["Target contract"]
    end
    SIG -->|valid| EX
    GAS --> EX

title: Cross-EntryPoint Replay and 7702 Bypass
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A["Attacker captures signed UserOp"] --> H{"userOpHash binds EntryPoint?"}
    H -->|"No binding"| R["Resubmit via 2nd EntryPoint"]
    R --> RE["Account re-executes transfer"]
    RE --> LOSS["Funds drained twice"]
    subgraph OtherFailures["Other failure modes"]
        E1["ECDSA-only ecrecover"] --> X1["Smart accounts excluded"]
        E2["onlyEOA / tx.origin check"] --> X2["7702 delegated EOA bypass"]
        E3["No nonce check in validateUserOp"] --> X3["In-EntryPoint replay"]
    end
    X2 --> LOSS
    X3 --> LOSS

title: Binding, Nonce and Signature Defenses
mermaid:
flowchart TD
    S["Build userOpHash"] --> BIND["Bind chainId + EntryPoint addr"]
    BIND --> GATE{"_requireFromEntryPoint"}
    GATE -->|"ok"| N["Enforce nonce via NonceManager"]
    N --> SC["Verify with SignatureChecker"]
    SC --> RET{"Signature result?"}
    RET -->|"valid"| OK["Execute callData"]
    RET -->|"mismatch"| CODE["Return SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED"]
    RET -->|"malformed"| REV["Revert, do not mask"]
    subgraph Safe7702["EIP-7702 safe"]
        D1["Drop onlyEOA / tx.origin"]
        D2["Bound recipient callback gas"]
    end
    OK --> Safe7702
